Description
Manchester's modern university for future thinkers, Manchester Metropolitan University is dedicated to giving students industry-focused skills. With a diverse range of accredited courses, many offering internship opportunities, Manchester Met is a fantastic choice for career-focused students. Global industry partnerships and links to international companies like Nike, IBM, Bentley Motors, Volkswagen, Walt Disney and many more. Career-boosting, industry-focused degrees accredited by one of more than 70 professional bodies including: ACCA, AMBA, CMI, EQUIS and RIBA.The UK’s greenest and most sustainable university (People & Planet University League 2021).Manchester Met is known for Manchester School of Art – one of the UK’s oldest art schools – as well as the Manchester School of Architecture.A global top 1% business school (MBA Today List of Triple-Accredited Business Schools 2021) with a great value price. Manchester Met is the most affordable triple-accredited business school in the UK for undergraduate students.
